waivers.total: the coverage job runs on the Linux runner, where a few OS-specific branches stay unexercised, so the Linux measurement sits slightly below the Windows one; the floor is pinned to the lower of the two so both an enforcing CI run and a local run hold it
waivers.tools: same reason as total: the tools/ scripts carry platform branches (process spawning, path forms) that measure about 0.3 points lower on the CI runner than on this host
waivers.tyrano: the area lost its well-covered Electron build / audio / autoplay / verify modules when the mobile-conversion chain was removed, so the remaining modules (asar, clean, ui_lang, tyrano_extract, pipeline) carry the whole area at 77.7%; the area floor is re-recorded for the smaller module set
